svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lathe: flange 44 mm outside x 25 mm; plug 35.0 mm x 40 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (0.08 mm a side in the rod: bonded, not a slide fit).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 30 mm from the plug end to 8 mm from the back face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End wall: 10 mm hole 10 mm below the axis (cable) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm hole 10 mm above it (guide tube); deburr; grommets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side of the flange, away from the button line: drill and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tap 1/4 BSP 12.5 mm from the back face into the bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pins: drill 4.0 mm top and bottom through rod and plug

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm in front of the flange after bonding (step 2).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: plug enters the rod fully; barb seals with tape.
